The '''1764 [[FLLA]] World Cup''' was the 1764 edition of the [[FLLA World Cup]], the quadrennial international [[wikipedia:association football|association football]] tournament contested by the senior men's national teams of the member associations of the [[FLLA]]. The tournament was contested by 32 nations drawn from seven continental confederations.

[[Easuhura]] won the tournament, defeating [[Emara]] 2–1 in the [[#Final|final]] to claim its first World Cup title. [[Verusa]] finished third after defeating [[Seytinemas]] 3–2 in the third-place playoff. [[Emara]] finished as the tournament's leading goalscorer with 17 goals, winning the [[wikipedia:Golden Boot|Golden Boot]].

==Qualification==

A total of 32 places at the tournament were allocated across the seven continental confederations of the [[FLLA]]. The qualifying tournaments are summarised below; full results are recorded on the individual confederation pages.

=== [[NFLA]] (Atirha) ===
4 slots — North America format: first-round groups followed by a final octagonal round-robin.

Qualified teams:
* {{Flagicon|Raledria}} [[Raledria]]
* {{Flagicon|Grazail}} [[Grazail]]
* {{Flagicon|Gaeiya}} [[Gaeiya]]
* {{Flagicon|Genaire}} [[Genaire]]

=== [[AFLA]] (Ayuma) ===
5 slots — Europe format: five group-stage groups, group winners qualify directly.

Qualified teams:
* {{Flagicon|Emara}} [[Emara]]
* {{Flagicon|Lycroa}} [[Lycroa]]
* {{Flagicon|Verusa}} [[Verusa]]
* {{Flagicon|Easuhura}} [[Easuhura]]
* {{Flagicon|Siana}} [[Siana]]

=== [[NAFLA]] (New Ayre) ===
4 slots — South America format: a single 23-team double round-robin league.

Qualified teams:
* {{Flagicon|Astye}} [[Astye]]
* {{Flagicon|Mendereide}} [[Mendereide]]
* {{Flagicon|Iainoa}} [[Iainoa]]
* {{Flagicon|Isari}} [[Isari]]

=== [[EFLA]] (Mahea) ===
5 slots — Europe format: five group-stage groups, group winners qualify directly.

Qualified teams:
* {{Flagicon|Seytinemas}} [[Seytinemas]]
* {{Flagicon|Trian}} [[Trian]]
* {{Flagicon|Isnti}} [[Isnti]]
* {{Flagicon|Exilium}} [[Exilium]]
* {{Flagicon|Chaenia}} [[Chaenia]]

=== [[QFLA]] (Quia) ===
4 slots — Asia format: first-round groups followed by a two-group final round.

Qualified teams:
* {{Flagicon|Finae}} [[Finae]]
* {{Flagicon|Anymna}} [[Anymna]]
* {{Flagicon|Wundry}} [[Wundry]]
* {{Flagicon|Erkizil}} [[Erkizil]]

=== [[MFLA]] (Massir) ===
5 slots — Asia format: first-round groups followed by a two-group final round.

Qualified teams:
* {{Flagicon|Sanagara}} [[Sanagara]]
* {{Flagicon|Haiza}} [[Haiza]]
* {{Flagicon|Taval}} [[Taval]]
* {{Flagicon|Vesozata}} [[Vesozata]]
* {{Flagicon|Dahe}} [[Dahe]]

=== [[CFLA]] (Acrola) ===
5 slots — Africa format: first-round groups followed by single-leg knockout playoffs.

Qualified teams:
* {{Flagicon|Terressin}} [[Terressin]]
* {{Flagicon|Pelines}} [[Pelines]]
* {{Flagicon|Acetoa}} [[Acetoa]]
* {{Flagicon|Viussi}} [[Viussi]]
* {{Flagicon|Jshain}} [[Jshain]]
